title: gzlite release history
description: What configure wrote at legacy starter revisions and tagged gzlite releases, generated by tools/build_release_history.py. Identical configure states are stored once as snapshots. Templates are raw text with {{...}} placeholders left in place.

snapshots.description: Distinct configure states, keyed by '<declared version>-<first 12 hex of the SHA-256 of the snapshot's canonical JSON>'.

releases.description: One entry per included release tag, in version order.

revisions.description: Every commit reachable from v0.13.0 with a release tag among its ancestors, plus included gzlite tag commits from v0.14.0 onward. Each maps to its own snapshot and to the latest tag at or before it.

managed_path.description: A repository-relative POSIX path, optionally prefixed by a marker and a colon. Markers: none = whole file, always written. 'if-absent:' written only when the file did not exist, then project-owned. 'merged:' host configuration into which configure merged its marketplace and plugin entries while preserving other content; no template. 'merged-if-exists:' used instead of the host's 'merged:' path when this file already existed (OpenCode opencode.jsonc); no template. 'adr-local:' written only when the lock's adr_policy.mode is 'local'. Content source by path: 'AGENTS.skills-first.md' uses fragment_template (placeholders rendered when adr_placeholders); '<surface>/skills/<update_skill>/SKILL.md' uses update_skill_template; '.agents/skills/<front_door_skill>/SKILL.md' uses front_door_skill_template; 'if-absent:AGENTS.md' uses agents_md_template; 'adr-local:<state>/architectural-decisions.md' uses adr_policy_template byte for byte. '<state>/bundle.lock.json' has no template: it is generated JSON (indent 2, final newline) with top-level keys lock_keys, where starter is {repository: origin, version, revision} and components are the bundle pins.

version.description: template_version declared by the commit's bundle.json; untagged commits may declare a version that was never tagged (0.3.2) or one tagged later.

origin.description: ORIGIN written to the lock's starter.repository and the marketplace source.

marketplace.description: Native catalog name used in host configuration and plugin keys.

fragment_template.description: AGENTS.skills-first.md as read by configure (UTF-8, LF).

update_skill.description: Name of the managed update skill (update-gz-template from the 0.6.0 line), or null when configure wrote none.

update_skill_template.description: The update skill's SKILL.md (UTF-8, LF), or null.

adr_placeholders.description: True when configure replaced {{ADR_POLICY_WORKING_SOURCE}} and {{ADR_POLICY_CANONICAL_URL}} in the fragment.

hosts.description: Hosts configure accepted, sorted. A lock without a host key means codex.

managed_paths.description: Per host, in configure's write order, every path configure wrote.

front_door_skill.description: Starter front-door skill written under .agents/skills (the 0.1.0 and 0.2.0 lines), or null.

front_door_skill_template.description: The front-door skill's SKILL.md (UTF-8, LF), or null.

agents_md_template.description: AGENTS.md text written when the project had none.

lock_keys.description: Top-level lock keys in write order; 'host' is written only for a host other than codex.

adr_policy_source.description: Starter path of the ADR policy recorded in the lock's adr_policy.source_path, or null when configure had no ADR policy.

adr_policy_template.description: The ADR policy's exact text, copied byte for byte in local mode, or null.

adr_policy_url.description: Canonical policy URL with {ref} standing for the adopter's recorded revision, or null.
